latest_release.body:
<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at 10.0.0 -->

## What's Changed
### ⚠️ Breaking Changes
* feat: make IEtcdClient extend IDisposable by @shubhamranjan in https://github.com/shubhamranjan/dotnet-etcd/pull/348
### 🚀 Features
* feat: track etcd 3.7.3 API, expose RangeStream, AuthStatus, Downgrade, LeaseLeases, MemberPromote by @shubhamranjan in https://github.com/shubhamranjan/dotnet-etcd/pull/347
### 🐛 Bug Fixes
* fix(watch): wait for etcd to acknowledge a watch before returning by @shubhamranjan in https://github.com/shubhamranjan/dotnet-etcd/pull/313
* fix(lock,election): add Lock/Campaign overloads that take an explicit lease by @suleymanbyzt in https://github.com/shubhamranjan/dotnet-etcd/pull/321
* fix(watch): bind deadline and cancellation token to the watch, not the shared stream by @shubhamranjan in https://github.com/shubhamranjan/dotnet-etcd/pull/346
* fix(kv,watch): compute prefix range ends on bytes, as etcd does by @shubhamranjan in https://github.com/shubhamranjan/dotnet-etcd/pull/349
### 📦 Dependencies
* deps: Bump Grpc.Tools from 2.81.1 to 2.82.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/shubhamranjan/dotnet-etcd/pull/311
* deps: bump all NuGet packages and GitHub Actions to latest, group Dependabot updates by @shubhamranjan in https://github.com/shubhamranjan/dotnet-etcd/pull/345
### 🔧 Maintenance & CI
* test: fix integration flakiness from shared-etcd cross-contamination by @shubhamranjan in https://github.com/shubhamranjan/dotnet-etcd/pull/312
* chore(lock,election): follow-ups from #321 by @shubhamranjan in https://github.com/shubhamranjan/dotnet-etcd/pull/344
* test: hardening before 10.0.0 — orphaned tests, watch failure paths, coverage floor by @shubhamranjan in https://github.com/shubhamranjan/dotnet-etcd/pull/350

## New Contributors
* @suleymanbyzt made their first contribution in https://github.com/shubhamranjan/dotnet-etcd/pull/321

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/shubhamranjan/dotnet-etcd/compare/9.1.0...10.0.0
